verdict.rationale: sevDesk is a bookkeeping SaaS that could plausibly ship automation rules, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only automatic booking-category suggestions, partner integrations and a REST API, with nothing on versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations. The API is a developer building block, not this capability, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
